# opnsense_quagga_ospf6_redistribution (Data Source)

Reads one OPNsense OSPFv3 redistribution rule by UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the redistribution rule.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description for this redistribution rule.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this redistribution rule is enabled.
- `redistribute` (String) Routing source redistributed into OSPFv3.
- `route_map` (String) UUID of the route map applied to redistributed routes.
